metadata.description:
An "Exclusively Public" 18-Hole championship course, Baywood Greens offers golfers the most scenic and spectacular golf on the Delmarva Peninsula.

Described as the “Augusta of the North”, at Baywood Greens you will experience the meticulously manicured woodside and waterside nines with eight timbered bridges and 27 acres of man-made ponds, two tunnels and over 200,000 flowers, plants, shrubs and trees.

metadata.description:
Lauded as one of the area's "Must Play" courses, Frog Hollow has been challenging players of various levels since its opening in 2000. Frog Hollow offers golfers the challenge and beauty of Kentucky Blue Grass rough, superbly manicured bent grass tees, fairways and-unique to the area-undulating true rolling greens.  More than fifty strategically placed bunkers, ponds, on six holes and high native grasses throughout add to the beauty and the challenge of Frog Hollow.
And now Frog Hollow is more than just great golf!  The additions of The Pub Restaurant & Bar and the Ivystone Room banquet facility have turned Frog Hollow into a destination club.  The Pub features fresh American dining in a casual atmosphere.  The Ivystone Room banquet facility is perfect for weddings, private parties, or golf outings.
